notes.title: Closed Prototype Testing Phase 1
notes.content:
Hi all,

Thanks for liking / wish listing the project.

As Sea Raiders is a project made for game streaming communities, we are looking into co-designing with you !

We are starting the next batch of tests of the prototype of Sea Raiders.

Looking for streamers who want to share and test  live collaborative play with their community !

Like pirate themed fun / goofy adventure ? 

Please reach out to streamers@watchagames.com 

Looking forward meeting you.

Thanks

Sea Raiders Team
